selected_evidence.requirement: Minimum 12 characters and at least three character classes
selected_evidence.summary: Configuration shows minlen=12 and minclass=3. Pre- and post-restart behavioral tests rejected both noncompliant cases and accepted a compliant password.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID dbb46974-b99f-4850-81d2-22dfbdf7b8ed, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed changed boot ID 9d45fac2-d740-44ee-b6cf-52813cf20c0a, and confirmed SSH, filesystem, account database, PAM configuration, and password enforcement recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
probe_user=pwpolicyprobe
if getent passwd "$probe_user" >/dev/null; then echo 'probe user already exists; refusing to reuse it' >&2; exit 1; fi
sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$probe_user"
len_bad="Q7!a$(od -An -N4 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n' | cut -c1-7)"
class_bad="a7$(od -An -N5 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')"
strong="Q7!a$(od -An -N4 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')"
printf 'generated_lengths length_bad=%s class_bad=%s strong=%s\n' "${#len_bad}" "${#class_bad}" "${#strong}"
set +e
printf '%s:%s\n' "$probe_user" "$len_bad" | sudo -n chpasswd >/tmp/pw_len.out 2>&1
len_rc=$?
printf '%s:%s\n' "$probe_user" "$class_bad" | sudo -n chpasswd >/tmp/pw_class.out 2>&1
class_rc=$?
printf '%s:%s\n' "$probe_user" "$strong" | sudo -n chpasswd >/tmp/pw_strong.out 2>&1
strong_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'length_11_change_rc=%s\n' "$len_rc"
sed -n '1,6p' /tmp/pw_len.out
printf 'two_class_12_change_rc=%s\n' "$class_rc"
sed -n '1,6p' /tmp/pw_class.out
printf 'four_class_12_change_rc=%s\n' "$strong_rc"
sed -n '1,6p' /tmp/pw_strong.out
printf 'probe_account_status='; sudo -n passwd -S "$probe_user" | awk '{print $1,$2}'
[ "$len_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$class_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$strong_rc" -eq 0 ]
